title: French Language Services Advisory Committee - November 16, 2023

agenda_items.title: Notices and meeting information for meeting participants and the public
agenda_items.description:
Members of Committee and Council, City staff, media and the general public may join the meeting with this link:
Zoom no. 822 9025 1667
Notices and meeting information are attached to the agenda and minutes, including: availability of simultaneous interpretation and accessibility accommodations; personal information disclaimer for correspondents and public speakers; notices regarding minutes; and remote participation details.
Accessible formats and communication supports are available, upon request.
The deadline to register to speak by phone or email, or submit written comments or visual presentations is 4 pm on the day of the meeting.

agenda_items.title: Declarations of Interest
agenda_items.minutes: No Declarations of Interest were filed.

sub_agendas_items.title: Election of Chair and Vice-chair
sub_agendas_items.minutes:
Member N. Sénéchal was acclaimed as the Chair of the Committee. 
Member M. Brownhill was acclaimed as the Vice-chair of the Committee.

motions.motion_text:
Recommendation
That the French Language Services Advisory Committee elect a Chair and Vice-Chair.

sub_agendas_items.title: French Language Services Advisory Committee 2023-2026 Work Plan
sub_agendas_items.minutes: Michèle Rochette, Manager, French Language Services, presented an overview of the process for establishing a French Language Services Advisory Committee 2023-2026 work plan, along with recommended next steps. Following questions and discussions, the committee accepted the recommended next steps in establishing a work plan.

motions.motion_text:
Recommendation
That the French Language Services Advisory Committee receive an update and begin discussions regarding its 2023-2026 Work Plan.

sub_agendas_items.title: 2024 Draft Operating and Capital Budget – French Language Services Advisory Committee
sub_agendas_items.minutes: Michèle Rochette, Manager, French Language Services, and Isabelle Jasmin, Deputy City Treasurer, presented an overview of the French Language Services portion of the draft 2024 operating and capital budget. Following questions from Committee, the Committee received the staff presentation, as well as carried Motion No. FLSAC 2023-01-01.

motions.motion_text:
Recommendation
That the French Language Services Advisory Committee receive the presentation for information.

BE IT RESOLVED that the French Language Services Advisory Committee (FLSAC) authorize the FLSAC Chair and Vice Chair to submit the Committee's consolidated comments on the 2024 Draft Operating and Capital Budget to the Committee Coordinator in advance of December 5 for circulation to Members of the Finance and Corporate Services Committee and Council.

agenda_items.minutes: There were no in camera items.
